content_sections.heading: NCERT Assistant Editor at a Glance
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not specify an application fee. National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT), located at Sri Aurobindo Marg, New Delhi, is an apex organisation assisting the government in school education matters. This recruitment is being conducted by the Department of Education in Languages (DEL) for staffing the PAB project titled "E-Magazine Sapnon Ki Udaan" (Sl. No. 22) on a temporary engagement upto 31 March 2027.

rows.details: National Council of Educational Research & Training (NCERT)
Bachelor degree with PG Diploma in Book Publishing/Mass Communication/Journalism and 5 years' experience

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their completed application form along with self-attested supporting documents via email to [email protected] . The complete application must reach the designated inbox latest by 01.11.2026 at 11:59 PM . Applications received after the scheduled date and time will not be entertained and may be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The eligibility requirements, age criteria, and desirable qualifications for the post of Assistant Editor are as follows: Essential Educational Qualification: Bachelor degree from a recognized University and Post Graduate Diploma in Book Publishing/Mass Communication/Journalism, where editing is one of the subjects. Essential Experience: Five years' experience in editing, producing-planning and supervising publications especially school textbooks, monographs and reports in a responsible capacity. Desirable Qualification: Knowledge of books production techniques, modern process of printing, typography and should be proficient in English/Hindi/Urdu; proficiency in word processing and techniques of online editing. Age Limit: Not more than 45 years / not more than 65 years in case of retired person from government organization (Relaxation as per GoI norms). Tenure: Upto 31st March 2027 (likely to be extended). Exclusion on Experience: Time spent by candidates pursuing M.Phil. and/or Ph.D. degree shall not count as teaching or research experience for the purpose of eligibility. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Candidates need to attach self-attested scanned copies of the following documents along with their filled-in application form via email: Completed and signed application proforma (including details of educational and professional qualifications). Recent passport size photograph signed across. Proof of educational and professional qualifications (certificates/mark sheets). Work experience certificates from relevant organisations. Attested copy of salary slip, bank statement, or Income Tax Return (ITR) proving the claimed experience as an essential eligibility condition. No Objection Certificate (NOC) if currently employed, or proof of application forwarded through their employers. Signed undertaking regarding prior engagement period in NCERT (if applicable).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection will be conducted through shortlisting followed by a personal interview. Shortlisting: Applications received by email will be screened based on the essential eligibility criteria, qualifications, and relevant experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for the interview. Interview: Shortlisted candidates must appear for the interview at NCERT, New Delhi. No TA/DA will be paid by NCERT for attending the interview. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must bring their original certificates/testimonials along with self-attested photocopies of each related certificate/document and one passport size photograph at the time of interview, failing which they will not be allowed to attend the interview.

content_sections.text: Selected candidates may be required to join immediately. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in NCERT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 vacancies for the post of Assistant Editor under the Department of Education in Languages.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 01.11.2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for NCERT Assistant Editor?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor degree from a recognized University and a Post Graduate Diploma in Book Publishing/Mass Communication/Journalism where editing is one of the subjects, along with five years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the post?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 45 years, and not more than 65 years in case of retired persons from government organisations, with relaxations applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for NCERT Assistant Editor?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 56,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates submit their application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send the completed application proforma along with scanned copies of supporting documents to the email ID [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent or contractual post?
faq.answer: The post is purely on a temporary project basis upto 31st March 2027, with the possibility of extension.

faq.question: Q8. Can retired government employees apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, retired personnel from government organisations can apply up to the age of 65 years.

faq.question: Q9. What are the desirable qualifications for the Assistant Editor post?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include knowledge of book production techniques, modern printing processes, typography, proficiency in English/Hindi/Urdu, and proficiency in word processing and online editing techniques.
